revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.justification: Primary business health indicator; answers 'Are we growing revenue?'

active_customers.label: Active Customers
active_customers.justification: Measures market traction; answers 'How many customers actually transacted?'

avg_order_value.label: Avg Order Value
avg_order_value.justification: Measures spend depth; answers 'Are customers buying more per transaction?'

churn_rate.label: Churn Rate
churn_rate.justification: Retention metric; answers 'Are we losing customers between periods?'

conversion_rate.label: Conversion Rate
conversion_rate.justification: Operational efficiency metric; answers 'What share of orders are successfully fulfilled?'
